instruction: Find the maximum value in the Present Value column (column B) and apply bold formatting to that cell.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum Present Value and making it bold. Verified with Python: max value is 227382 at cell B5. Evaluator checks if B5 has bold formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction has two requirements (1) find maximum value in column B, (2) apply bold formatting. Evaluator only verifies requirement #2
Hardcoded cell reference B5: Evaluator assumes B5 contains the max without dynamically verifying it actually is the maximum value in column B
Logic gap: Evaluator cannot distinguish between 'user correctly found max at B5 and bolded it' vs 'user blindly bolded B5 without checking if it contains the max'
The metric function only checks if cell.font.bold == True for B5, but does not read and compare values across column B to verify B5 actually contains the maximum
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Metric function should read all non-empty cells in column B and compute the maximum value dynamically
Metric should identify which cell contains the max value (might not always be B5 if data changes)
Then check if that specific cell (the one with max value) has bold formatting applied
Alternative approach: Use two separate checks - one metric to verify B5 contains the max value in column B, another to verify B5 is bold
